title: Telangana SI Prelims 2026: negative marking, pass marks, hall ticket

items: TGPRB SCT SI exam · Sunday 29 Nov 2026
scenes.say: Telangana S I prelims aspirants, careful! Wrong answers will cost you marks. Here is what the official notice says.
scenes.sub: Telangana SI prelims aspirants, careful! Wrong answers will cost you marks. Here is what the official notice says.

items: Wrong answer: minus 20% of its marks
scenes.say: One. Negative marking. A correct answer gets full marks. A wrong answer, or more than one bubble darkened, cuts twenty percent of that question's marks. A question left blank gets zero, with no cut. So don't guess blindly.
scenes.sub: One. Negative marking. A correct answer gets full marks. A wrong answer, or more than one bubble darkened, cuts 20% of that question's marks. A question left blank gets zero, with no cut. So don't guess blindly.

scenes.say: Two. Minimum marks to qualify. Thirty percent for O C and E W S, twenty five percent for B C, and twenty percent for S C, S T and ex-servicemen.
scenes.sub: Two. Minimum marks to qualify. 30% for OC and EWS, 25% for BC, and 20% for SC, ST and ex-servicemen.

items: Entry 1 hour early · 1 minute late = no entry
scenes.say: Three. The exam is on Sunday, twenty ninth November, from ten A M to one P M. Over one lakh sixty thousand candidates, in about three hundred thirty five centres. Entry starts one hour early, and even one minute late means no entry.
scenes.sub: Three. The exam is on Sunday, 29 November, from 10 AM to 1 PM. Over 1,60,000 candidates, in about 335 centres. Entry starts one hour early, and even one minute late means no entry.

items: Paste your photo with gum, not pins
scenes.say: Four. Download your hall ticket from T G P R B dot in, from twenty second November, eight A M, till twenty eighth November midnight. Paste your photo on it with gum, not pins or staples.
scenes.sub: Four. Download your hall ticket from tgprb.in, from 22 November, 8 AM, till 28 November midnight. Paste your photo on it with gum, not pins or staples.

scenes.say: The official notice link is in the description. More free updates on Marg Disha dot com.
